changeSet.sql: CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pgcrypto;
CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS reimburse;

changeSet.author: hirevo
hirevo
hirevo
changeSet.sql:
CREATE TABLE reimburse.cash_advances ( id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), tenant_id UUID NOT NULL, employee_id UUID NOT NULL, request_no VARCHAR(50), purpose TEXT, amount NUMERIC(18,2) NOT NULL, needed_date DATE, status VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK (status IN ('pending','approved','rejected','disbursed','settled','cancelled')), approval_instance_id UUID, disbursed_at TIMESTAMPTZ, settled_at TIMESTAMPTZ, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW() );
CREATE TABLE reimburse.cash_advance_settlements ( id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(), tenant_id UUID NOT NULL, cash_advance_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES reimburse.cash_advances(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, reimbursement_request_id UUID, settled_amount NUMERIC(18,2) NOT NULL, refund_amount NUMERIC(18,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, shortfall_amount NUMERIC(18,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, settled_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW() );
